raw_text: Armed clashes erupted in Khartoum early Saturday between the Sudanese Armed Forces under General Burhan and the Rapid Support Forces led by General Hemedti. Fighting is concentrated around the presidential palace, army headquarters, and Khartoum International Airport. Both sides claim the other initiated hostilities. Civilian casualties reported in crossfire.
